In this nebulous riot, dimly, I can see June Law's back, can hear the persuasive voice of Jean Middleton selling raffle tickets, admire the towering majesty of Alf's form, watch the palm rubbing of John Baker.
Will you please convey my sincere thanks to all Belgravians for the very generous donation for Mount Vernon Hospital - which I feel is a great tribute to Alf.
It was interesting to see what it had grown into - most impressive. Alf would have been delighted with it. I have kept in touch with some of his contemporaries, though sadly, numbers are dwindling.
